latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary. (text of measure as introduced: CR S4261-4262)
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

relatedBills.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 554) to prevent legislative and regulatory functions from being usurped by civil liability actions brought or continued against food manufacturers, marketers, distributors, advertisers, sellers, and trade associations for claims of injury relating to a person's weight gain, obesity, or any health condition associated with weight gain or obesity.
